name: mail
description: The inbox from the terminal, for more than one account: sign in to Gmail, Yahoo, iCloud, Fastmail, Zoho, Proton, Forward Email or any IMAP host with the right kind of password, then list and search over IMAP, read a message, reply in its thread, send a new one over SMTP with Resend as the fallback, and mark, file or delete without a browser tab.
